method.engine: market entry at next 5m open only (round-4 honest survivor; no fill-order ambiguity). Walk-forward, production market_tools+fvg logic, no lookahead, conservative tie=loss (bar spanning stop and target = LOSS), stop fills at stop, positions never span sessions. Simulator imported from backtest_chart_v4 unchanged; incumbent replay reproduces the round-5 report trade for trade before anything else runs.
method.grid: TP FIXED 0.4r x buf 0.1/0.2 x gap floor 1.0/1.1 (cap 3.0 fixed) x run cap none/8 x day-eff floor none/0.15 (cap 0.85 fixed) x est-risk cap none/3.6 x hours ge7/ge8 x drop-sets {inc, inc+EUR/USD}; perday fixed 1
method.split: first 38 calendar days = in-sample, remaining 39 days (from 2026-06-01) = out-of-sample, untouched by selection and the dissection tables
method.selection: rank IS-passing configs by Wilson 95% lower bound of win rate then avg R; walk down checking the OOS gate (>=60% wr, >=60 trades, avg R > 0); peek cap 6; PRE-COMMITTED final rule: the procedural winner replaces the incumbent only if OOS wr > 77.8 and OOS avg R >= 0.05

incumbent.rules: grade A FVG only; market entry at next 5m open (no retrace wait); stop beyond FVG far edge +0.1 ATR; TP 0.4R all-out; FVG gap >= 1.1 ATR; gap < 3.0 ATR (cap); skip if day efficiency >= 0.85; entries only 7:00 ET or later; dropped: BTC/USD, GBP/USD, Gold; max 1 trade/symbol/day; 6-bar cooldown

selection.final_rule: pre-committed before any OOS number of this round was computed: procedural winner replaces the incumbent only if OOS wr > 77.8 and OOS avg R >= 0.05; TP fixed 0.4r a priori

procedural_winner.rules: grade A FVG only; market entry at next 5m open (no retrace wait); stop beyond FVG far edge +0.1 ATR; TP 0.4R all-out; FVG gap >= 1.0 ATR; gap < 3.0 ATR (cap); skip if run-from-open >= 8.0 ATR; skip if day efficiency >= 0.85; entries only 7:00 ET or later; skip if est. stop distance >= 3.6 ATR; dropped: BTC/USD, GBP/USD, Gold; max 1 trade/symbol/day; 6-bar cooldown
procedural_winner.verdict: beats the incumbent's published 77.8% OOS wr with avg R >= 0.05

best.rules: grade A FVG only; market entry at next 5m open (no retrace wait); stop beyond FVG far edge +0.1 ATR; TP 0.4R all-out; FVG gap >= 1.0 ATR; gap < 3.0 ATR (cap); skip if run-from-open >= 8.0 ATR; skip if day efficiency >= 0.85; entries only 7:00 ET or later; skip if est. stop distance >= 3.6 ATR; dropped: BTC/USD, GBP/USD, Gold; max 1 trade/symbol/day; 6-bar cooldown

honest_note: Selection used ONLY the first half (market-entry engine, conservative tie=loss); TP fixed at 0.4r a priori so Wilson ranking cannot crown a tighter target. 6 OOS gate checks this round + 1 fixed-config looks. Cumulative OOS-look ledger: 19 through round 5 + 7 this round = 26 total looks. Related configs in a 128-point grid share information; treat OOS numbers as an upper bound of true edge.
